description: ProtonMail email connector via ProtonMail Bridge (Tier-4 EMAIL class). ProtonMail is end-to-end encrypted, so the local ProtonMail Bridge app decrypts mail on the user's machine and exposes a standard IMAP/SMTP interface on the loopback interface (127.0.0.1:1143 IMAP / 127.0.0.1:1025 SMTP) with Bridge-generated credentials. This connector indexes the user's mailbox over that local IMAP listener as `protonmail:email` items — message HEADERS (subject, from, to/cc, date, message-id), a short capped plain-text body PREVIEW (~2 KB / 2000 chars), and attachment METADATA only (filename, size, mimetype). It NEVER downloads or parses attachment bytes and never fetches the full message body. Read tools (`protonmail_list`, `protonmail_get`, `protonmail_search`) plus one HITL-gated write tool (`protonmail_mail_send`) that sends mail over the Bridge SMTP relay. Bridge credentials arrive as scoped environment variables injected at spawn time (PROTONMAIL_HOST/PROTONMAIL_PORT/PROTONMAIL_USERNAME/PROTONMAIL_PASSWORD and PROTONMAIL_SMTP_*) — the connector never reads the vault. Because Bridge listens on the loopback interface with a self-signed certificate, the connection uses STARTTLS without certificate verification (it never leaves 127.0.0.1); the concrete 127.0.0.1:1143 + 127.0.0.1:1025 host:port entries are added to the sandbox network allow-list at spawn time by phase3AddProtonmailMcp.
